name: distinct-developments-three-independent-developments,-three-keyed-slots
reading:
Cedar United has appointed Jo Vale as head coach on a two-year contract, while goalkeeper Kim Park is set to miss the next match due to an ankle injury with no return date specified.

Cedar United secured a 2–1 victory against Vale City on Sunday, marking their latest result in the league.
review: Keep each development attached to its own supporting report_key; do not transfer claims between reports.
The ankle injury, the appointment and the result are three stories, not one narrative.
